question: Compare the lost-link settings of the Matrice 30T, Matrice 4T, EVO Max 4N, and Matrice 210 V1.

intake.reason: question asks for guidance/manuals/incident references on lost link behavior (return-to-home, hover, land, reconnect) across listed models.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims: AC 107-2A instructs reestablishing the control link or following loss-of-control procedures, and to land, hover, or execute a return-to-home sequence if VLOS cannot be regained. Manuals claims: for Matrice 30T, loss of signal can trigger RTH, land, or hover; RTH may be Advanced RTH or Original Route RTH under lighting or vision constraints; a disconnected icon appears, and reconnection does not restore prior control. For Matrice 4T, failsafe RTH occurs if signal is lost when set to RTH, with Pilot 2 displaying the pre-loss RTH path and continued RTH if the signal returns; Original Route RTH can occur under poor lighting/vision.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states, when the control link is lost, the instruction is to try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft, and if connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states, if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.
claims.quote: If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that the remote PIC may need to land the small unmanned aircraft immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.
claims.quote: the remote PIC may need to land the small unmanned aircraft immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.

claims.text: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover.
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover

claims.text: If RTH is chosen, the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: If lighting is not sufficient and vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.

claims.text: If the signal is lost, the icon will display a disconnected status in red.
claims.quote: If the signal is lost, the icon will display a disconnected status in red.

claims.text: If the disconnected remote controller reconnects with the aircraft during the flight, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device.
claims.quote: If the disconnected remote controller reconnects with the aircraft during the flight, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device.

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
claims.quote: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the signal was lost.
conditions: lighting and environment conditions suitable for the vision system

claims.text: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.

claims.text: When the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
conditions: lighting and environment conditions unsuitable for the vision system

C010.rationale: The passage states that DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path when lighting and environment conditions are suitable for the vision system, matching the claim's condition.

C011.rationale: The passage explicitly says the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

C014.rationale: The cited manual passage states: "If the Home Point was successfully recorded and the compass is functioning normally, Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds." This matches the claim, including conditions (Home Point recorded, compass functioning normally) and the trigger (>3 seconds signal loss).
